trait.name: Blaze Rod
entries: When the blaze drops to 0touché points, it disappears in a cloud of smoke and has a 50 percent chance of leaving behind a glowing rod worth 100 gp. The rod sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. As an action, une créature can try to snap the rod, doing so with a successful {@dd 14}Force check. The snapped rod releases its fiery energy in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 14}Dextérité saving throw, taking 6 ({@dégât 1d12}) firedgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.

trait.name: Heat Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 mètres of the blaze takes 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) firedgts.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The blaze sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 mètres.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: The blaze takes 1 colddgts for every 5 mètres it moves in water, for every gallon of water splashed on it, or lorsqueever it starts its turn in the rain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blaze makes three Fiery Doom attacks.

action.name: Fiery Doom
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 6} pour toucher; allonge 5 m, or ranged 60 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d10 + 3}) firedgts, and la cible catches fire if it's une créature or a flammable object. Until une créature takes an action to extinguish the fire, the burning target takes 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) firedgts at the end of each of its turns.

trait.name: Bizarre Physiology
entries: The creeper can't take actions except for {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, and {@action Search}. It can't take bonus actions or reactions.

trait.name: Creeper Head
entries: When a creeper drops to 0touché points from a charged creeper's explosion (see the Destruction trait), it dies and its head falls off. A creeper's fallen head is hollow and can be worn as a mask with eye and mouth openings.

trait.name: Destruction
entries: When it ends its turn within 10 mètres of a Humanoid that it can see, the creeper stops moving and emits a hiss loud enough to be heard by creatures within 30 mètres of itself.
Si  creeper drops to 0touché points before the start of its next turn, the hissing stops, and the creeper dies. Otherwise, at the start of the creeper's next turn, one of following things happens:

items: If there are no Humanoids within 10 feet of the hissing creeper, it stops hissing. It then uses any available movement to approach the nearest Humanoid it can see.

If there are one or more Humanoids within 10 feet of the hissing creeper, the creeper explodes in a ball of energy that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. This energy spreads around corners. The creeper is destroyed, and every other creature in the explosion's area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Increase this damage by 7 ({@damage 2d6}) if the creeper is charged (see "Electrical Charge" below). Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage, or 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage if the creeper is charged.

trait.name: Electrical Charge
entries: Whenever the creeper is subjected to lightningdgts, it takes nodgts and instead becomes charged for 1 minute. While charged, the creeper emits dim blue light in a 5-foot radius.

trait.name: Fear of Felines
entries: The creeper has the {@condition effrayé} condition lorsqueever it starts its turn within 60 mètres of a feline creature it can see. The condition lasts until the start of the creeper's next turn.

trait.name: Dragon Egg
entries: When the Ender Dragon drops to 0touché points, it radiates beams of purple light and then disappears, leaving behind an inert, jet-black dragon egg worth 5,000 gp.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: Si  dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and uses Beating Wings.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} pour toucher; allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}18 ({@dégât 3d6 + 8}) piercingdgts plus 7 ({@dégât 2d6}) necroticdgts.

action.name: Beating Wings
entries: The dragon beats its great wings. Each creature within 15 mètres of the dragon doit réussir on a {@dd 21}Dextérité saving throw or take 10 ({@dégât 1d4 + 8}) bludgeoningdgts, be pushed 10 mètres away from the dragon, and have the {@condition à terre} condition.

action.name: Harmful Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales putrid gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 21}jet de sauvegarde Constitution, taking 52 ({@dégât 15d6}) necroticdgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one. The dragon then chooses a point it can see where the cone makes contact with the ground. That point becomes the center of a 10-foot-high, 10-foot-radius cylinder of lingering gas that disappears at the start of the dragon's next turn. Any creature that starts its turn in the cylinder takes 10 ({@dégât 3d6}) necroticdgts.

trait.name: Evasive Teleportation
entries: Whenever it takesdgts or is la cible of a ranged attack, the Enderman can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 mètres of itself (no action required). If this effect is triggered by a ranged attack, the Enderman teleports just before the attacktouchés, causing the attack to miss it. This trait is suppressed while the Enderman has the {@conditionincapacité} condition.

trait.name: Implosion
entries: When the Enderman drops to 0touché points, it dies as its body implodes. Roll a {@dice d10}. On a roll of 9 or less, the Enderman leaves no remains. On a roll of 10, the Enderman leaves behind a glowing, purple orb called an Ender pearl, worth 500 gp. A creature can throw the pearl up to 60 feet; if the pearl lands in an unoccupied space big enough to contain la créature, la créature teleports to that space, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, and the pearl disappears.

trait.name: Sensibilité à la lumière du soleil
entries: While in sunlight, the Enderman désavantage aux jets d'attaque.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: The Enderman takes 1 colddgts for every 5 mètres it moves in water, for every gallon of water splashed on it, or lorsqueever it starts its turn in the rain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Enderman makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Coup
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher; allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts plus 9 ({@dégât 2d8}) necroticdgts.

trait.name: Tactique de groupe
entries: The wolf avantage aux jets d'attaque against une créature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 mètres of la créature and the ally doesn't have the {@conditionincapacité} condition.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} pour toucher; allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 2d4 + 2}) piercingdgts. If la cible is une créature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 11}Force saving throw or have the {@condition à terre} condition.
